static_traits.name: 刘天宇
static_traits.family_status: 配偶（丈夫）已去世，丈夫生前为销售员
static_traits.social_status: 有几位亲密朋友可倾诉，但尚not yet与他们讨论对烹饪的恐惧；涉及餐食的Social gatherings受到影响
static_traits.medical_history: without显著躯体疾病；without以往心理问题治疗史或咨询经历
static_traits.language_features: Clear expression and coherent logic, able to concretely describe emotions and thoughts; high cooperation, but shows tension and worry when cooking is mentioned

basic_info.main_problem: 我在烹饪方面缺乏自信，导致完全回避做饭。一次失败的晚宴后Persistent anxiety，害怕每次做饭都会很糟糕。
basic_info.core_demands: A persistent fear of failing at cooking has begun to affect my overall mood and daily life, so I hope to resolve this problem through counseling.
growth_experiences: 一次在家中举办的晚宴因试图取悦客人而承受较大压力，结果餐食严重失败。该事件后，来访者对烹饪的Self-efficacy显著下降，逐渐形成“每次做饭都会很糟糕”的Anticipation，并产生强烈Anxiety与羞耻；随后开始尽可能回避做饭，更多依赖预制食品或外卖，且在涉及餐食的社交场合中感到受影响。

core_beliefs: 如果not能让他人满意，我就是失败者

special_situations.event: 当Thinking about having to cook（without论是为自己还是为他人）时
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I try cooking again, I will definitely fail like last time and the result will be terrible
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Trying to avoid cooking, relying on prepared foods or takeout to reduce risk
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我又会搞砸，这次也会很糟糕

special_situations.event: 参加涉及餐食的Social gatherings（可能需要自己下厨或带菜）
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果菜not够好，do not人就会评判我，觉得我not行
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoids joining parts that require cooking, reducing exposure in meal-related settings
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 大家会因为我做得not好而看not起我

special_situations.event: 回忆那次失败的晚宴并以此作为对not yet来的参照
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 一次失败证明我以后都会失败
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Uses that failure as grounds to refuse further attempts in order to avoid being set back again
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 上次那么糟，这证明我not适合做饭

core_conflict.wish: 渴望通过烹饪被他人认可与赞赏
core_conflict.fear: 害怕失败后被他人评判、羞辱与negate
defense_goal: 通过Avoids cooking来避免失败与被评判，维持脆弱的自我价值感

object_relations.self_representation: not够好的、容易失败的自己（尤其在烹饪领域）
object_relations.object_representation: 挑剔且会评判自己的他人/观众

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When talking about cooking again or facing social scenes involving meals
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 将他人的关注理解为潜在批评与negate，认为自己若not完美就会被羞辱（移情：将他人视为苛刻的评判者）
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 倾向以回避和替代方案回应，如强调继续use外卖或预制餐以“先稳定心态”。语气谨慎，少承诺高难度任务，use保守措辞（例如“先等等”“not要冒险”）。

manifestations: 因害怕餐食not佳被评判而减少参与与餐食相关的Social gatherings
Avoids cooking导致与他人共享餐食与互动的机会减少

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others, corresponding to 'possession'. Language manifestations include: 'He is looking down on me', 'They want to exclude me', and so on
manifestations: 预设他人会因为做得not好而评判自己
在餐食相关场景中将内在羞耻与恐惧归因为“do not人会看not起我”

positive_force: 工作中曾出现“Anticipation会失败但结果Good”的经验，说明具备在压力下完成任务的能力
职业表现稳定，护理工作not yet受该问题影响
态度积极，愿意寻求帮助并尝试改变
拥有几位可倾诉的朋友（尽管尚not yet讨论烹饪恐惧）
negative_force: 灾难化、预测not yet来、过度概括、非黑即白等认知偏差显著
过度在意他人评价，担心被评判与羞辱
Avoids cooking并依赖预制餐/外卖，Reinforcement恐惧循环

target_behavior.behavior: 对烹饪的强烈Anxiety与回避（几乎not做饭，转而依赖外卖/预制餐）
antecedent: Thinking about having to cook（为自己或为他人）
回忆那次失败的晚宴并以此推断not yet来结果
target_behavior.core_reason: 失败晚宴后形成灾难化与非黑即白的认知框架，为取悦他人的高期待与对评判的恐惧结合，导致Self-efficacy显著下降
target_behavior.function: 逃避可能的失败与被评判，短期降低Anxiety与羞耻感
target_behavior.consequence: 饮食习惯受影响、社交参与度下降、持续Self-denial与Anxiety worsened，生活质量降低
